CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 5
   C. 5
   D. 4

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

4. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

6. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

7. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 11

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

13. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 11

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
